opinions.name: GitHub Copilot
opinions.point: fine for translation and lookups, not trusted for code
opinions.quote: I've used Github Copilot to translate between languages and look things up, but haven't trusted it to write new code or fix anything.

opinions.name: Claude

opinions.quote: Claude Fable is now good enough that I should be using it… But Anthropic's business practices are scary. They have a reputation for cancelling accounts for random reasons, offer rather bad terms, and have no customer support.

opinions.name: OpenCode Go/Zen

opinions.quote: This month I used 1 billion tokens (including cache) with DS4.1 flash and it cost me 7% of my $10 opencode go sub.

opinions.name: Claude

opinions.quote: So mine [portfolio agent] runs every morning to read the news… A daily blog for status and reasons for decision making works pretty well for tracking an agent that works unattended.

opinions.name: Claude Code

opinions.name: Claude Code

opinions.name: Claude Code
opinions.point: surprisingly great to use
